mapper.insert: insert into log_auth_record (event_id, trace_id, request_id, user_id, username, auth_event_type, auth_channel, request_uri, request_method, client_ip, client_location, user_agent, device_type, http_status, result_status, failure_code, failure_message, token_id, occurred_at, created_at) values (#{eventId}, #{traceId}, #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{authEventType}, #{authChannel}, #{requestUri}, #{requestMethod}, #{clientIp}, #{clientLocation}, #{userAgent}, #{deviceType}, #{httpStatus}, #{resultStatus}, #{failureCode}, #{failureMessage}, #{tokenId}, #{occurredAt}, now(3))
mapper.select: select id, event_id as eventId, trace_id as traceId, request_id as requestId, user_id as userId, username, auth_event_type as authEventType, auth_channel as authChannel, request_uri as requestUri, request_method as requestMethod, client_ip as clientIp, client_location as clientLocation, user_agent as userAgent, device_type as deviceType, http_status as httpStatus, result_status as resultStatus, failure_code as failureCode, failure_message as failureMessage, token_id as tokenId, occurred_at as occurredAt from log_auth_record where event_id > #{eventId} order by event_id asc limit #{limit}
